development.fallback: Local fixtures and offline cache only.
development.validation: Both values are empty; no remote backend initializes.

staging.validation: HTTPS origin plus publishable/anon key; never service_role; both values supplied together.

production.validation: Production HTTPS origin plus scoped publishable/anon key from the release secret store; never committed.

development.validation: GOOGLE_AUTH_ENABLED is false and no provider is contacted.

staging.validation: Current application boundary rejects an enabled flag until an owned HTTPS domain is verified.

production.validation: Current release boundary rejects an enabled flag; activation requires a separately reviewed owned-domain configuration.

staging.validation: Exact allowlisted HTTPS callback; no wildcard, query, fragment, user info or alternate port.

production.validation: Exact reviewed HTTPS callback and matching provider/app-link configuration before OAuth activation.

development.validation: Map flags are false unless an explicit local test adapter is used.

staging.fallback: Status-only tracking UI; native adapter remains disabled.
staging.validation: Enabled and native-configured flags must both be true; key remains outside Git and is restricted to the staging app.

production.fallback: Status-only tracking UI; no provider invocation.
production.validation: Billing, quota, app-restricted native key and shop enable flag are all required before both map flags may be true.

development.fallback: Only non-online methods exposed by fixtures are selectable.
development.validation: Online payment configuration remains notConfigured; no real purchase.

staging.validation: Sandbox provider, webhook signature, reconciliation and idempotency must pass before server publication.

production.validation: Production provider approval, secret store, signed webhook, refund/cancel and reconciliation gates are all required.

development.fallback: Unconfigured provider returns no token and requests no permission.
development.validation: No APNs/FCM credential or production token is present.

staging.fallback: Unconfigured provider returns no token and requests no permission.
staging.validation: Environment-scoped APNs/FCM configuration and package/bundle match before activation.

production.fallback: Unconfigured provider returns no token and requests no permission.
production.validation: Production APNs/FCM keys, entitlement and backend sender configuration are all present before activation.

development.validation: Bounded typed events only; central redaction and no remote exporter.

staging.validation: A reviewed exporter, environment separation, consent, sampling and privacy negative tests are required before injection.

production.validation: Explicit owner/privacy approval and a reviewed production exporter are required; payload remains typed, sampled, redacted and bounded.

development.validation: No raw error, stack secret, token or personal data is exported.

staging.validation: Separate bounded reporter, timeout and redaction tests pass before injection.

production.validation: Explicit owner/privacy approval, environment-scoped DSN/configuration and central redaction are required.

development.validation: No real customer, courier or production coordinate data.

staging.validation: Owner-scoped RLS, bounded realtime/polling, retention and shop mode are verified before live-courier activation.

production.validation: Production migration, RLS, retention, provider gates and shop activation switch must all be ready.

development.fallback: Local fixtures use no remote shop.

staging.validation: Public lowercase slug matches the canonical staging shop and the bounded slug grammar.

production.validation: Public lowercase slug is owner-approved and resolves only to the intended production shop.

development.validation: Only fixed test origins and sanitized synthetic identifiers are accepted.

staging.validation: Server-issued HTTPS URL satisfies the allowlist and failure falls back to order status.

production.validation: Approved HTTPS carrier origins, privacy review and shop switch are required.

development.validation: Development environment selects local structured output with redaction.

staging.validation: Staging environment never emits raw requests, secrets, identifiers or coordinates.

production.validation: Production environment excludes debug logging and permits only reviewed bounded adapters.
